research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: dNovo Bio is researching systems and methods for transdifferentiation, as described in 'Transdifferentiation of non-dermal papilla cells to dermal papilla cells,' which details converting non-dermal papilla cells into induced dermal papilla cells for hair loss treatment, and in 'Transdifferentiation of non-hair follicle stem cells to non-auditory induced hair follicle stem cells,' which focuses on generating induced hair follicle stem cells from non-hair follicle sources. These efforts target cell reprogramming for regenerative applications.
